tex_content.html: \begin{exercise} \end{exercise} 1. ch12:12-1Suppose $(M, g)$ is a simply connected (but not necessarily complete) Riemannian $n$-manifold with constant sectional curvature. Prove that there exists an isometric immersion from $M$ into one of the model spaces $\mathbb {R}^n$, $S^n(R)$, $\mathbb {H}^n(R)$. \end{exercise}
